versions.changelog:
- Provides an OOMOL skill for operating Jimeng AI through the `jimeng_ai` connector and `oo` CLI.
- Supports async image generation, text-to-image, video generation, image-to-video, smart upscale, and Lilinque video agent workflows.
- Includes submit and result-retrieval actions for Jimeng AI Image Generation 4.0/4.6, Text-to-Image 3.0/3.1, and Video Generation 3.0 variants.
- Documents schema-first usage so payloads are built from live connector contracts before running actions.
- Adds safety guidance for write actions and first-time setup troubleshooting for auth, connection, credit, and CLI issues.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`

- Provides OOMOL-backed access to Jimeng AI through the `jimeng_ai` connector and `oo` CLI.
- Supports async submission and result retrieval for Jimeng image generation 4.0 and 4.6.
- Includes text-to-image 3.0 and 3.1 workflows with matching result polling actions.
- Covers Jimeng video generation 3.0 in 720P, 1080P, Pro, first-frame, and first-and-last-frame variants.
- Adds Smart Upscale plus Lilinque Smart Video Agent and Marketing Video Agent task flows.
- Documents schema-first execution, credential handling, safety tags, and first-time setup recovery steps.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`

- Initial release of the `oo-jimeng-ai` skill for operating Jimeng AI through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Adds 28 connector actions for submitting async media-generation tasks and retrieving their results.
- Supports Jimeng text-to-image, image generation, video generation, image-to-video, and Smart Upscale workflows.
- Includes 720P, 1080P, and Pro video-generation variants, plus first-frame and first-and-last-frame image-to-video modes.
- Adds Lilinque Smart Video Agent and Marketing Video Agent actions, including Smart Video Agent 2.0 workflows with or without reference videos.
- Documents the recommended `oo connector schema` and `oo connector run` flow so payloads are built from live connector schemas.
